name: Ingredient story
description: Where a product came from, told on the product page without turning it into a brochure.
designQuestion: How much origin story earns its place next to a buy button?
context: The brand team writes beautiful origin copy that nobody reads, because it lives at the bottom of the page behind a tab.

explorations.title: Three beats
explorations.premise: Grower, process, result. Three short moments, interleaved with the product imagery.
